decoding.FACT: the official output of the last block (Block._eval with the gtea.yaml mwt) on an all-zero label sequence; no B3, no mwt, switch-cost or threshold search
decoding.diagnostic: the same weights' frame-branch argmax of the last block; a readout of the trained system, not a token-free ablation

readings.complete_system_progress: FACT - A01 ASRF, FACT - A01 Linear + B3 and FACT - frozen Ordered + B3 are consistent positive in multi segment F1@50 in both halves, every seed and half meets the recall and native floors, and the goal's means are met; at most a system advance on this development protocol, never originality, clinical validity or a causal contribution of cross-attention
readings.learned_system_gain_without_strong_refer: FACT - A01 ASRF and FACT - A01 Linear + B3 are consistent positive in both halves while complete_system_progress does not hold; the failed condition (frozen Ordered comparison, a floor or the goal) is named; no overall win is claimed
readings.one_half_or_local_effect: (a) any of the four F1 comparisons (A01 ASRF, A01 Linear + B3, frozen Ordered + B3, A01 MS-TCN) is consistent positive in at least one half, or (b) only point estimates improve: pooled over seeds, FACT recovers more reference segments than it loses (all segments, segments of at most 16 samples, or A4C/A5C X-Y-X middles) against A01 ASRF, A01 Linear + B3 or frozen Ordered + B3 in a half, counted separately for native clips, pair streams and multi streams; every item is listed with its population, denominator and intervals, and point estimates are kept apart from consistent evidence
readings.trade_off: in some seed and half, against A01 Linear + B3 or frozen Ordered + B3, FACT recovers at least one reference segment while it also has a new unmatched predicted segment, a lower native macro-F1 point estimate or a recall or native floor failure in that seed and half; the counts and intervals of those cells are listed; it describes coexistence, needs no cross-seed significance and proves no cause; without this pattern it is not applied
readings.uncertain_or_no_qualifying_gain: complete_system_progress does not hold; the primary comparison's direction in each half is reported; no interval containing zero is called equality, and one configuration never rejects a model family
readings.end: after the one report this official GTEA, video-feature and budget combination closes; no extra seed, Breakfast configuration, more tokens or layers, encoder fine-tuning, loss, optimiser, epoch or decoder search, reference boundaries, boundary subdivision, teacher, gate or fusion follows automatically

goal.rule: three-seed means at or above both minimums and, in every seed and half, boundary recall >= 0.95 and native macro-F1 at the floor; FACT has no B3 feasibility condition because its main output has no B3, and the floors are not relaxed for it; passing the old goal does not replace the comparison with the strong reference
